$comment: Tools added to Install Manager by data. One entry per tool; see electron/install-extensions.cjs for the allowed fields. The owner's own list is <FRIDAY folder>/config/install-extensions.user.json and an update never touches it. The tools here are the programs a FRIDAY feature runs that the built-in catalog does not install: the C and C++ compiler of the project runner (kernel/runner.py), the speech synthesiser of the offline voice fallback (kernel/stt.py), and the PHP and C# helpers of the same runner.

tools.manual: PHP's package manager, used by the project runner for composer.json. Needs PHP first. Install it from getcomposer.org/download.
Runs a single C# file (.cs) for the project runner. Needs the .NET SDK first. In a terminal: dotnet tool install -g dotnet-script
